name: Apple
description: Apples are crisp, sweet, or tart fruits packed with dietary fiber, vitamin C, and various antioxidants, making them a perfect healthy snack.

faqs.a: Apples contain natural sugar (fructose) but have a low glycemic index because they are high in fiber, which slows digestion and prevents blood sugar spikes.
Yes, much of the fiber and antioxidants (like quercetin) are concentrated in the skin, so eating apples whole is highly recommended.
